system.description:
Cursed: each use moves the Doom Clock forward 5 minutes and makes you Cursed. Pinhead (OPDQ): choose a target and roll a Strange Check. For each Strange symbol, the target takes 2 Sharp damage and must make a Fear Check.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.160
system.summary: Cursed: each use moves the Doom Clock forward 5 minutes and makes you Cursed. Pinhead (OPDQ): choose a target and roll a Strange Check. For each Strange symbol, the target takes 2 Sharp damage and must make a Fear Check.

automation.label: Pinhead
automation.onSuccess: For each Strange symbol, the target takes 2 Sharp damage and makes a Fear Check.
automation.onFail: No Strange symbols: the target is unharmed.

automation.note: Pinhead: target your victim before clicking Roll. A success deals the first 2 Sharp damage to it automatically. Deal 2 more Sharp damage by hand for each further Strange symbol. The target also makes a Fear Check for each Strange symbol (a Strange Check; the Director sets the CR) by hand. While Cursed you can't heal; the Curse ends only when the doll is destroyed.
